title: EDMCOverlay Integration - NOTE this feature is largely superceded by the superior MiniBar and SubTitles bar features. Recommeend you use those instead.
Use EDMCOverlay Integration
desc: If ON and EDMCOverlay is installed, will display some messages on your HUD (NOTE: doesnt display in VR)

title: Show Guidance Computer bearing and distance to target
desc: If ON will display the bearing and distance to your target coordinates in the overlay, when using the Guidance Computer

title: Show starport landing pad directions
desc: If ON will display the location of your landing pad when requesting docking at a starport

title: Overlay X position on screen
desc: The X coordinate of where to place the overlay message on your HUD

title: Overlay Y position on screen
desc: The Y coordinate of where to place the overlay message on your HUD

title: Overlay font size
desc: The size of the font used in the overlay

title: Overlay font color
desc: The color of the font used in the overlay

title: Font color custom color (hex)
desc: The hex value of the custom color. Default is 00ff00 (green).
